content.short: Bitvavo is a regulated European exchange and one of the largest venues in the Netherlands.
content.description: Bitvavo is a European crypto exchange offering spot trading with a documented API surface for programmatic access. Developers can connect through an Exchange REST API, a WebSocket API or a FIX API depending on how their system is built. A separate Market Data Pro WebSocket feed carries higher-frequency market data, and an Account Management REST API covers institutional account operations.
content.meta: Bitvavo is a regulated European crypto exchange from the Netherlands, offering spot trading plus REST, WebSocket and FIX APIs.
